0.headline: AceVector IPO subscribed 1.8x on Day 3 so far; check latest GMP trends
0.heading: AceVector IPO subscribed 1.8x on Day 3 so far; check latest GMP trends
0.intro: The company's shares are scheduled to debut on the stock exchanges on October 5.
0.body:
The initial public offering of SoftBank-backed digital commerce ecosystem AceVector Ltd was subscribed 1.84 times on the third day of bidding on Tuesday.

The IPO received bids for 13.64 crore shares against 7.42 crore shares on offer, according to NSE data till 12:45 pm.

The portion reserved for retail investors was subscribed 2.35 times, while the quota for non-institutional investors received 2.04 times subscription.

The Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) portion was subscribed 1.42 times.

Earlier, the company had raised Rs 189 crore from anchor investors.
Check All IPO News

AceVector IPO GMP Today Price
According to platforms tracking grey market activities, the shares of AceVector are commanding a GMP of up to 6 percent. Investgorgain quoted a GMP of Rs 2 for the shares of the company, indicating a listing gain of 6.25 percent. Meanwhile, IPO Watch, quoted a GMP of 1.56 percent.

The price band for the IPO has been fixed at Rs 30-32 per share.

The company's shares are scheduled to debut on the stock exchanges on October 5.

AceVector operates an asset-light digital commerce ecosystem comprising Snapdeal, a value-focused lifestyle e-commerce marketplace; Unicommerce, an e-commerce enablement SaaS platform; and Stellaro Brands, an omnichannel consumer brands retailing business.

1.headline: Shah Investor's Home IPO subscribed 55% on Day 2 so far; check latest GMP
1.heading: Shah Investor's Home IPO subscribed 55% on Day 2 so far; check latest GMP
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Shah Investor's Home continued to see subdued investor interest on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 55 percent subscription as of 12:15 pm on September 29, as per NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Shah Investor's Home continued to see subdued investor interest on the second day of bidding, with the issue receiving 55 percent subscription as of 12:15 pm on September 29, as per NSE data.

The Rs 90.17-crore IPO received bids for 20,86,410 shares against 37,79,440 shares on offer. The qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) and non-institutional investors (NIIs) categories were subscribed 61 percent each, while the retail investor portion was subscribed 50 percent.

In the grey market, Shah Investor's Home shares were commanding a premium of nearly 8 percent on the morning of September 29, according to InvestorGain.

Read Also: SRIT India IPO subscribed over 2x so far on Day 2; GMP at 25%

However, the grey market premium (GMP) is an unofficial indicator and can change before listing. It does not guarantee the actual listing price or future performance of the stock.

Shah Investor's Home is looking to raise around Rs 90.17 crore through the IPO. The company has fixed the price band at Rs 159-167 per share.

At the upper end of the price band, the company is seeking a valuation of around Rs 353.25 crore.

The company plans to use Rs 60 crore of the net IPO proceeds towards working capital requirements. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

Shah Investor's Home reported a profit of Rs 13.2 crore for the financial year ended March 2026, down 43.5 percent from Rs 23.4 crore in the previous year.

Revenue also declined 24.2 percent year-on-year to Rs 71.5 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 94.3 crore in FY25.

Shah Investor’s Home operates in the financial services and securities market and competes with listed small-cap players such as SMC Global Securities, Share India Securities and Arihant Capital Markets.

The IPO is expected to see its share allotment finalised by October 1. The equity shares are scheduled to be listed on the BSE and NSE on October 6.

2.headline: SRIT India IPO subscribed over 2x so far on Day 2; GMP at 25%
2.heading: SRIT India IPO subscribed over 2x so far on Day 2; GMP at 25%
2.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) of Bengaluru-based IT solutions provider SRIT India continued to attract investor interest on the second day of bidding, with the issue subscribed over 2 times as of 11:30 am on September 29, according to NSE data.
2.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of Bengaluru-based IT solutions provider SRIT India continued to attract investor interest on the second day of bidding, with the issue subscribed over 2 times as of 11:30 am on September 29, according to NSE data.

The Rs 218.4-crore IPO received bids for 2,32,56,450 shares against 1,17,60,000 shares on offer, translating into a subscription of 1.98 times. Retail investors led the demand, with their portion subscribed 3.11 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) category was subscribed 1.96 times.

In the grey market, SRIT India shares were commanding a premium of 25 percent on the morning of September 29, according to InvestorGain.

Read Also: Orient Cables IPO subscribed over 11x so far on final day of bidding; GMP at 27%

However, the grey market premium (GMP) is an unofficial indicator and is based on transactions taking place outside the formal market mechanism. GMP can change before listing and does not guarantee the actual listing price.

SRIT India opened its IPO for subscription on September 28, and the issue will close on September 30.

The company has fixed the price band at Rs 123-130 per share. The IPO lot size is 115 shares, meaning retail investors need to invest a minimum of Rs 14,950 at the upper end of the price band.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of 1.68 crore shares.

The company plans to use the proceeds from the issue towards working capital requirements, modernisation and redevelopment of existing products, acquisitions and general corporate purposes.

About SRIT India

SRIT India is a Bengaluru-headquartered IT and IT-enabled services company that provides digital solutions, automation and custom application development services.

The company is scheduled to list its equity shares on the BSE and NSE on October 6.
